description: Two hooks. UserPromptSubmit runs the lexical dispatch router (router_rules.json) over a substantive human prompt and injects a short <toolkit-dispatch> block naming at most two candidate skills; silent unless HUMBLEPOWERS_DISPATCH_PROMPT_INJECT=1, silent on no match. Disable the router (and thus the hook) with HUMBLEPOWERS_DISPATCH_ROUTER=0. SubagentStop runs the verification-before-completion gate, which blocks a subagent's first stop once with a discipline reconsideration; it is OFF unless HUMBLEPOWERS_VERIFICATION_SUBAGENT_GATE=1, and fails open on any error. See the plugin README to enable either; read the router telemetry back with `inject_dispatch.py --health`.
